serialization: recursively sort JSON object keys lexicographically, preserve array order, JSON.stringify without whitespace, hash UTF-8 bytes

content_normalization.leading_trailing_whitespace: trimmed per line; outer blank lines removed
content_normalization.repeated_internal_whitespace: horizontal tab/vertical tab/form feed/space runs become one space
content_normalization.blank_lines: three or more consecutive LF become one blank line (two LF)

field_order_contract: projection field arrays above are normative; serialized object keys are canonicalized lexicographically
